Hi Laura / Marissa,

Following the performance calibration conversation yesterday, we have a high-priority coverage risk on the infra team: Samir (Sr. Infra IC, Eng#1345) is moving to a parental leave window starting early January and the role is critical for our Q1 latency SLO work. People Ops has flagged the role for backfill approval but we are inside the hiring freeze exception window.

Request: Can leadership sign off a conditional backfill exception that allows us to start candidate outreach and secure 2-weeks of contractor coverage before Samir leaves? The ask is conditional on:
- a short-term 3-month contractor or internal loan to avoid SLO regression,
- prioritized requisition with a targeted on-site bar for January interviews, and
- a limited budget cap not to exceed the approved temporary headcount pool.

Attached: backfill-request-form.docx and perf-summary-q3.pdf (shows impact areas and risk heatmap).

Rationale: this is time-sensitive — if we wait for normal freeze lift, the infra roadmap (model-serving kernel rollout) will slip and force higher-cost remediation later. I propose the following mitigations to keep this minimal:
1) Restrict approval strictly to contractor coverage first; perm hire to follow a formal req and payband approval.
2) Use internal float (two engineers from adjacent squads) for initial on-call rotation for 4 weeks.
3) Weekly check-ins with Marissa as product lead on progress and risk.

Can you please reply with: APPROVE / APPROVE-CONDITIONAL / DENY and any comments by EOD Friday so we can engage People Ops and Talent?

Thanks,
Hannah

Summary of my decision and conditions:
- APPROVAL MODE: APPROVE-CONDITIONAL (contractor first; perm req to be re-opened after freeze if still needed).
- COST LIMIT: Contractor spend capped at $16k/month (benchmarked against recent cloud infra contractors).
- OVERLAP: Samir will provide 10 business days of structured handover; hiring team to schedule knowledge-transfer sessions and record runbooks.
- RISK CONTROLS: Candidate slate must include at least one internal-transfer option and one external finalist; avoid cross-functional hiring that increases org churn.
- REPORTING: Weekly status note to me and Laura; immediate escalation if on-call incidents increase beyond baseline.

I've attached a short candidate-playbook.xlsx with criteria and a checklist for quick-screening. People Ops can start outreach once Hannah confirms cost and final language.
